title: 第6章 招募第7章 挑选
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
“嘿！伙计，你的宠物咬到我了！你得管管！”
街口，一个农夫打扮的中年男人突然一个趔趄，跌坐在地抱着自己的胳膊，这顿时引起一阵骚乱，周围的人群迅速散开，避免被误伤。
沃尔根本不相信对方的说辞，手握剑柄，立刻就要上前辩驳，青狼却突然转身，张开血盆大口咬向他腰侧！
“有敌人！”
沃尔这才感应到身后的异样，立刻转身一肘，同时拔出腰间长剑。
噌——“啊！”
一声惨叫传来，不过沃尔并没有击中的感觉，他的视线迅速扫视而过，只看到一个矮小的身影滚进人群阴影中消失不见，只在原地留下几滴鲜血。
沃尔再回头，果然，刚才那个叫嚣的中年男人也消失不见，而周围的行人都见怪不怪，见热闹结束，纷纷摇头散开。
显然，这是一出盗贼们常用的声东击西，沃尔这种初出茅庐的冒险者很容易中招，他虽然听说过，但这还是第一次体验，并不是运气好，只是以前身上从来没有过这么多钱而已。
好在，沃尔还有青狼这个长辈在。
比起略显慌乱的沃尔，青狼从头到尾游刃有余，连呼吸都没变过节奏。
敌人逃走，它也没有追击的想法，只是舔了舔嘴角，低头在血滴上仔细嗅闻。
沃尔拍拍青狼结实的背，轻松道：
“辛苦你了，青狼，中午请你吃大餐。”
青狼抬起头，耳朵动了动，摇摇头，带着沃尔向下方走去。
沃尔也加快脚步，对于同伴更加期待，如果自己身边多几个人同行，那些盗贼根本就不敢使用这种伎俩。
青木城虽然是骏鹰领唯三的大型人口聚集区，但城镇内部空间却并不太大，沃尔走了几分钟，便看到了高耸的外城城墙，还有那下方热闹的集市。
【冒险者集市】
这是由帝国冒险者注册法案规定的，冒险者指定接发任务区域，也是冒险者进行交易的地方。
沃尔这身装扮走到这里就显得很普通了，因为这里几乎所有人都穿戴甲胄，佩戴武器。

而且在这里，还有着大量的异族人类，长着动物特征的亚人，脸更加扁平圆润的蛮人，还有身材矮小的半身人，和矮小却粗壮的矮人。
同时，沃尔也看到了几个和自己同样是尖耳朵，但头发和瞳孔都如同黄金般璀璨的高等精灵。
而这边街道的商铺和摊子也不卖蔬菜水果，而是各种各样的怪物零件，武器、药水，还有刚从遗迹里挖出的“宝物”。
沃尔刚逛了几步，就看到了地上一摊老熟人。
“刚宰的哥布林，全是新鲜材料，你们看这大枪，效果顶顶好！”
摊主是一个满口黄牙的中年男人，他手持钢叉，腰间别着一柄短刀，唾沫横飞地向周围看热闹的菜鸟推销着。
而那摊子上，一只哥布林被分解成零件，牛牛被完整剌下来，还特意放在哥布林那血肉模糊的脑袋上架着展示。
沃尔见此，想起了昨天痛失的两具哥布林尸体，就算只是拔下它们的头皮，也能卖到上百个铜币了，那可是上好的皮靴材料，而且越老越值钱。
content_en:
"Hey! Dude, your pet bit me! You gotta take care of it!"
At the street corner, a middle-aged man dressed as a farmer suddenly stumbled and fell to the ground holding his arms. This immediately caused a commotion and the surrounding crowd quickly dispersed to avoid being accidentally injured.
Wall didn't believe the other party's words at all. He held the hilt of the sword in his hand and was about to step forward to argue. However, the green wolf suddenly turned around and bit his waist with a bloody mouth!
"There are enemies!"
Only then did Wall sense something strange behind him. He immediately turned around and pulled out the sword from his waist.
Ugh - "Ah!"
A scream came, but Wall didn't feel like he was hit. He glanced quickly and saw a short figure rolling into the shadows of the crowd and disappearing, leaving only a few drops of blood on the spot.
Wall turned around again, and sure enough, the middle-aged man who had just made a noise had disappeared, and the pedestrians around him were not surprised. Seeing that the fun was over, they shook their heads and dispersed.
Obviously, this is a common trick used by thieves to attack the west. It is easy for a fledgling adventurer like Wall to fall into this trap. Although he has heard of it, this is his first experience. It is not because he is lucky, but he has never had so much money before.
Fortunately, Wall still has the elder Qinglang here.
Compared to Wall, who was slightly flustered, Qinglang was able to do it from beginning to end without even changing the rhythm of his breathing.
The enemy fled, but it had no intention of pursuing it. It just licked the corners of its mouth, lowered its head and sniffed carefully at the blood drops.
Wall patted Qinglang's strong back and said easily:
"Thank you for your hard work, Qinglang. I'll treat you to a big dinner at noon."
Qing Lang raised his head, moved his ears, shook his head, and led Wall down.
Wall also quickened his pace, looking forward to his companions even more. If there were a few more people around him, those thieves would not dare to use this trick at all.
Although Aoki City is the only large-scale population gathering area in the Hippogriff Territory, the internal space of the town is not very large. After walking for a few minutes, Wall saw the towering outer city walls and the lively market below.
【Adventurer Market】
This is stipulated by the Empire's Adventurer Registration Act, and adventurers designate the area for receiving missions, which is also where adventurers conduct transactions.
Wall's outfit looks very ordinary when he comes here, because almost everyone here wears armor and weapons.
And here, there are a large number of alien humans, demi-humans with animal features, barbarians with flatter and rounder faces, short halflings, and short but stocky dwarves.
At the same time, Wall also saw several high elves with pointed ears like himself, but with hair and pupils as bright as gold.
The shops and stalls on the streets here do not sell fruits and vegetables, but instead sell various monster parts, weapons, potions, and "treasures" just dug out of the ruins.
Wall had just taken a few steps when he saw a group of old acquaintances on the ground.
"The goblins we just killed are all fresh ingredients. Look at this big gun, it's very effective!"
The stall owner is a middle-aged man with yellow teeth. He holds a steel fork and a short knife on his waist. He is selling to the novices watching the excitement around him.
In that stall, a Goblin was disassembled into parts, the body was stabbed completely, and the goblin's bloody head was placed on a display.
Seeing this, Wall thought of the two goblin corpses that he had lost yesterday. Even if they just pulled out their scalps, they could be sold for hundreds of copper coins. They were the best material for leather boots, and the older they were, the more valuable they were.
